name: box
form_origin: The stems leave the ground together and the crown reaches the ground with them: there is no bole, so bole_frac is 0 and the envelope's t=0 sits at the foot. leaders is the stem count of an established stool; the grower divides the declared stem section among them by the pipe model, so this is one plant and not 12. A bush is a multi-stem under about 2 m and its whole habit is the outer shell; dbh_cm is 0 because 1.3 m is nearly the top of it and a diameter measured there is not a stem diameter. lai 4.5 is above the shrub band because box is evergreen and holds several years of leaf.
dimensions_origin: [SET] from the mature open-grown band a European field guide gives the species; no measurement of an individual is claimed and every one is falsifiable against a photograph with a scale in it.
dbh_cm_origin: the diameter of ONE stem at 1.3 m; the grower solves its whole radius cascade against it and the pipe model gives the other stems the same section. 0 means the form carries no stem that reaches breast height and base_radius stands as declared.
lai_origin: [SET] one-sided leaf area per m2 of crown projection. A shrub layer measures below a closed forest canopy because it lives on what the canopy lets through; the band used here is 2...4 for an understorey woody and the value is placed within it by how dense the species' own foliage reads.
bark_origin: sRGB. Box bark is pale buff and finely checkered; on a bush this size almost none of it is visible.
